package spotify

// ddsonic composed stage only (M3b2 plan v7 §2.6): the shipped
// productionLibrespotSession (session_auth_ddsonic.go) without its go-test
// refusal, and nothing else. The SDK contract runner binds this file's bytes
// and checks, with go/parser and go/printer, that the shipped function is
// exactly this body behind that refusal (step 13). It is overlaid as
// external/spotify/composed_bypass_ddsonic_test.go, so it never compiles into
// a non-test build, and go test ./... never compiles it at all.

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/session"
)

func composedLibrespotSession(ctx context.Context, opts *session.Options) (*session.Session, error) {
	return session.NewSessionFromOptions(ctx, opts)
}
